name: update_offer_draft
description: Add only buyer-stated or explicitly accepted answers to the editable website offer draft. Never assume acceptance of Scott’s suggestions. Does not confirm, submit, contact anyone or create a contract.

parameters.description: Record only the buyer’s explicit answer to the opening spoken existing-agent question. No: exactly No other agent. Yes: exactly Working with another agent — coordinate before proceeding. Unsure: exactly Unsure about another agent — discuss before proceeding. Never infer No from an address or describe the buyer as self-represented. Pause on Yes/unsure; omit this field on other turns unless explicitly corrected.
Full buyer-supplied property address and unit, MLS number or listing link. Unverified.
Explicit buyer offer price in plain numeric US dollars, up to two decimals; no commas or dollar sign.
Buyer-confirmed escrow amount/percent, timing and additional deposit if supplied. Suggest 20%, but never assume acceptance.
Exactly Cash, Financing, or Discuss with Scott.
Buyer-confirmed inspection days or Discuss with Scott. Suggest 7 days and no more than 15; record only accepted terms.
Buyer-confirmed proposed payer for title insurance specifically. Scott suggests seller pays; negotiable.
Buyer-confirmed proposed closing company/person or payer selection. Scott suggests Greg Oropeza; subject to the choice of whoever pays title insurance.
Buyer-confirmed financing-contingency period or Discuss with Scott. Suggest 30 days; omit for cash.
Buyer-confirmed closing date or timeframe. Cash suggestion: 20 days if no title issues. Financed suggestion: 15 additional days after the financing-contingency period. No invented date.

Complete buyer-confirmed clauses and requests, including furniture or anything else raised in the final special-requests question. Preserve all previously accepted clauses when adding requests. Suggest seller close all open permits, including tree permits, before closing at seller expense; include only if accepted. No additional requests does not cancel accepted clauses. None only if buyer has no clauses or requests at all.
Buyer-stated legal name(s) for the proposed offer.
Buyer-stated contact email; confirm spelling if needed.
